entry_contract: exact unit, section, source/target file and line evidence
exact printed and PDF page after stable verified pagination

decision_policy.dictionary_absence: Make a reversible best-evidence translation, record the absence honestly and request review; do not leave a needed term untranslated solely for lack of an official entry.
decision_policy.locale: ps-Arab-PK; Pakistani Pashto usage and orthography are primary.
decision_policy.variants: Afghan Pashto remains a labelled regional comparator. A separate regional edition would require separate canon, terminology/register, semantic QA, rendering QA and publication receipts.

pagination.rule: Never guess page numbers. Populate exact printed/PDF occurrence pages only from an accepted stable reader and verified line-to-page mapping.
pagination.current: 14810 of 18814 canonical paired occurrences have exact printed/PDF pages derived from accepted stable-reader labels for v0.6.0-computability; the remaining 4004 occurrences explicitly say pending.
pagination.next: After each later reader reaches stable verified pagination, derive pages from embedded semantic-segment labels and regenerate and validate every canonical projection before packaging the next release.

release_disposition: The canonical review surfaces were included in the verified v0.6.0-computability source snapshot. Occurrence pages still identify the stable v0.6.0-computability PDF reader; later drafting remains pending until a new stable reader exists, and frozen earlier assets remain unchanged.
